Frequently Asked Questions
What is lemlist?
lemlist is an AI-powered sales engagement platform that finds leads, personalizes outreach, and runs multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp, SMS) - all in one place. From lead generation to enrichment, outreach automation, and deliverability, everything works together, so you don’t need multiple tools.
Who is lemlist for?
lemlist is built for sales and growth teams who want to spend less time on manual work and more time closing deals.
It helps:
→ Sales leaders ramp teams faster and hit targets
→ Sales ops streamline workflows and scale efficiently
→ SDRs and AEs focus on conversations instead of admin
Whether you're a solo founder, agency, or scaling team, lemlist gives you everything you need to build high-performing motion.
How does lemlist help with email deliverability?
Every lemlist seat includes built-in deliverability tools, including lemwarm, our automated warm-up and deliverability booster. It helps you build sender reputation, avoid spam, and keep your emails landing where they should, outside of spam.
Does lemlist comply with SOC 2 security standards?
Yes, lemlist is SOC 2 certified. This certification ensures that our systems and processes adhere to rigorous controls to protect your data and maintain high security and reliability standards.
Can I integrate lemlist with my current sales stack?
Yes. lemlist connects seamlessly with tools like HubSpot and Salesforce, so you can even manage lemlist outreach without leaving your CRM. With native integrations, MCP, and API access, it fits right into your team's existing workflow.
How can I get started with lemlist and see how it works?
You can 
book a personalized demo
 with our team or explore lemlist on your own with a 
14-day free trial
. Once you sign up, the dashboard will guide you through the setup step by step, and if you need help, our support team is just a click away via the in-app chat.

Easily segment leads for spot-on targeting
Connect with prospects that are interesting for you and by you. Use AI to extract key insights from raw data, like company size, seniority, job openings, and fundraising—so you can segment relevant audience and drive fast results.
Craft optimized sequences in just 1 click
Share your outreach details, and let lemlist AI create multichannel sequences from scratch at the right time, with right messages.
Use clean data for human-like messages
Avoid sounding robotic. Normalize dates, capitalize names, clean job titles, remove emojis, and more. All in one tool.
Make outreach feel personal with relevant details
Your leads expect you to know them and their business. lemlist AI does the heavy lifting, gathering key insights like competitor data and top pain points from LinkedIn bios, websites, and more. Use them to personalize every message at scale, without the research hassle.
Stand out with your voice, at scale
Let lemlist AI clone your voice from one recording. Add a script with smart variables and turn it into 1000s of custom notes.
Fine-tune messages for every lead
You’re a sales pro, not a copywriter. Let AI fine-tune your message for tone, length, and impact, so every word drives conversions.

Step by step guides to help you get the most out of AI
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the benefits of using AI for sales prospecting?
By generating highly personalized multichannel sequences and messages with AI, you can free up resources to focus on more strategic and value-added activities. This translates into saving costs and achieving more with less resources. In short, you have the power of multiple SDRs at your fingertips.
Which lemlist AI capabilities help salespeople?
lemlist AI helps thousands of salespeople by:
Generating personalized multichannel sequences with Campaign Generator, in under 3 mins
Segmenting, cleaning, and enriching data instantly with AI Variables
Fine-tuning every message for better results with the “Ask AI” Assistant
Detecting interested prospects so you never miss an opportunity via Interest Detector
Combining these actions can result in higher engagement, more opportunities, and more deals that bring revenue.
In which plans is lemlist AI available?
lemlist AI is included in every paid plan, plus a 14-day free trial, so you can unlock new business opportunities no matter your sales level or budget.
How to get started with lemlist AI?
lemlist AI sources data via your OpenAI account, which you can link to your lemlist in just a few minuts. Simply follow 
this step-by-step guide
 that will ensure you’re set for success.
 Is AI-based prospecting compliant with regulations?
lemlist AI sources data via your OpenAI account, which you can link to your lemlist in just a few minuts. Simply follow 
this step-by-step guide
 that will ensure you’re set for success.
Can AI replace human interaction in outreach?
While AI alone supports outreach efforts, the human touch remains critical for building relationships, understanding leads’ emotions, and making outreach relatable. That’s why combining AI and human interaction can enhance outreach efforts, instead of replacing them.

Frequently Asked Questions
What’s included in the 14-day free trial?
You get full access to the Multichannel plan for 14 days - no credit card required. After the trial, you can’t send new campaigns, but you’ll keep access to your account, campaigns, and leads.
What are lemlist credits and how do they work?
Credits are lemlist’s currency for unlocking features such as enrichment, verification, AI capabilities, call minutes, and more. They’re only charged when an action is successful. If you run out, you can top up anytime directly from your account - no plan upgrade needed.
What are add-ons and do I need them?
Add-ons are optional features, such as data enrichment or buying intent signals, that you can add to customize your plan. You can add or remove them anytime.
What can I do with the lemlist Chrome extension?
The extension lets you find contacts, enrich leads, personalize messages, or launch outreach directly from LinkedIn, Gmail, or CRM (depending on your active plan), without leaving your workflow.
Is lemwarm and deliverability protection included?
Yes. lemwarm and built-in deliverability protections are included in all plans to help keep your emails out of spam and protect your sender reputation at any scale.
When should I choose the Enterprise plan?
Enterprise is a good fit for larger or fast-growing teams that need centralized control. Think IT-managed orgs requiring SSO, companies with stricter compliance needs, or finance teams that can't pay by card. If self-serve no longer cuts it and you need structure, auditing, and dedicated support, Enterprise is the right move.
